ordinary_body_maximum_basis.source_wording: ordinary 1/4-in nominal bolt body maximum; no SKU dimensions inferred

scope_limits.note: This report screens enlarged shafts against retained geometry and peer maximum shafts, and each moving shaft sweep against one sampled counterhold shape. It does not screen tool envelopes against the enlarged peer-shaft map; nominal tool-route results cannot be upgraded to a maximum-diameter route result.

installed_occupancy_screen.exclusion_scope: Nominal installed shaft screened against retained geometry, peer shafts, and same-stack washer rings. Its own shaft/head/nut are removed as target assembly parts; nut internal thread fit is not modeled.

fixed_collision.exclusion_scope: Same retained map and target exclusions as the nominal exact-shaft screen. All twenty WJ-03 peer shafts use the schedule-audit class maximum; only shaft body occupancy changes.

ordinary_class_maximum_collision.exclusion_scope: One sampled stationary-nut ratchet heading only; other mutually exclusive headings are not unioned.
